name: Confirm Modal
description: Generic confirmation dialog. Displays a message (HTML, sanitized via regex to strip script/img/iframe/embed/object/link/style tags and event handlers), Cancel button, and configurable confirm button (default 'Delete', destructive red styling). Returns Promise<boolean> — true for confirm, false for cancel. Overlay click = cancel. Escape key = cancel. DOM element is removed on resolution (not just hidden).

interface.constructor: new ConfirmModal(message: string, confirmLabel?: string, destructive?: boolean)

methods.name: open
methods.description: Show modal, set up Escape handler, focus cancel button, resolve on action
